short:
Eliminate the
hostile animals
prowling around
the Central
Dome area!
long:
Client: Principal
Quest:
 Please eliminate the
 dangerous wildlife in
 the area around the
 Central Dome.

Good to see you,
<name job> <name hero>.

Let me get straight
to the point, again.

The way to the Central
Dome is now open.

We went in to further
investigate the reason
for the explosion.

But the search team was
attacked by those violent
wild animals down there.

There have been many
casualties already in
the Dome area...

I'd like you to go and
exterminate these
vicious beasts.

Our teams can't handle
it. We need the help of
you hunters.

My secretary, Irene,
has the details. Please
speak to her.
...I'm counting on you.

Please speak to
Irene, my secretary.
Rico...!

No, it's nothing.
Please continue your
mission.

Well done,
<name hero>!

Thanks to you, we can
investigate the Central
Dome at last!

I wonder if the people
of Pioneer 1 are
all right...

Is something on your
mind?

There was a pillar down
on Ragol with strange
markings on it?
Hmm.

My guess is that it was
a monument set up by the
Pioneer 1 settlers.

But... that does seem
a bit unusual, I admit...

Well, leave that to us,
for now, then.

Again, you did a good
job. Please, go and
get some rest.

You did a good job.
Please, go and get
some rest.

I hope we're able to
find the people of
Pioneer 1, safe.

Where do you think you're
going?

You haven't spoken with
Irene for the details,
yet!

Let me brief you on
your mission.

Orders are to exterminate
the <color 4>giant wild animals<color 0>
around the Central Dome.

I believe you've already
run into some of them, so
you should be prepared.

It will be a great help
if you can exterminate
all of them in the area.

Use the transporter to
get down to the surface
of Ragol.

I've heard that these
animals are tough.
Please, be very careful.
That is all.
Good luck.
Oh, also...

Regarding the Principal's
daughter, Red Ring
Rico...

Please tell me anything
that you find about her
whereabouts.
Thank you very much.

Enemies on the surface
of Ragol...

I wonder if Rico is all
right…

The Principal is waiting.
Please give him your
report.
Good work!

Now we can safely
investigate the Central
Dome.

Maybe we can get some
clues as to what happened
to Pioneer 1.

I hope that we can find
Rico, too…

We will call on you again
when needed.

Why don't you go and rest
up a bit, for now?

You have already
finished this quest.

Please select "Cancel"
at the Counter to
return to the Lobby.

When the people of
Pioneer 1 started to 
explore Ragol's surface,

they set up the Central
Dome as their base.

The Dome was built by
dismantling parts of
the ship.

Pioneer 1 was our
preliminary migration
vessel.

It was to serve as our
base of operations as we
settled on-planet.

It carried our military,
most of our scientists,
and many politicians.

Thanks to you, we can
safely investigate the
Central Dome.

I hope that the people
of Pioneer 1 are all
okay…

Pioneer 1 was designed to
be easily dismantled.

It was used to build
the Central Dome.

We still don't know what
happened to the Dome,
though…

The Central Dome was
going to be our initial
colony on Ragol.

But if we can't guarantee
the safety of our
citizens, we can't land.

With those wild animals
outside... if nobody from
Pioneer 1 is inside the

Dome, then I don't see
how anyone on Ragol could
possibly still be alive.
...don't you agree?

They say the giant pillar
is a monument built by
Pioneer 1, but...

Given recent events, I
think it warrants a more
thorough investigation.

And what about those
weird symbols? Could they
be letters?
